sn56.5:1.1: ye hi keci bhikkhave atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yathābhūtaṃ abhisambujjhiṃsu sabbe te cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtaṃ abhisambujjhiṃsu.
sn56.5:1.2: ye hi keci bhikkhave anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yathābhūtaṃ abhisambujjhissanti sabbe te cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtaṃ abhisambujjhissanti.
sn56.5:1.3: ye hi keci bhikkhave etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yathābhūtaṃ abhisambujjhanti sabbe te cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtaṃ abhisambujjhanti.
sn56.5:2.3: ye hi keci bhikkhave atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yathābhūtaṃ abhisambujjhiṃsu abhisambujjhissanti
sn56.5:2.5: sabbe te imāni cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtaṃ abhisambujjhanti. tasmā
sn56.5:3.1: tiha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
